title: Jonah and the Drop
author: Astrid Halloran
blurb: Kestrel Crane, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
